papers.title: Effect of surface modification of Ti-6Al-4V alloy by electron cyclotron resonance plasma oxidation.
papers.abstract: Ti-6Al-4V alloy is used as biomaterials for dental and orthopedic implants because of their excellent biocompatibilities and mechanical properties. However, it is unclear that electron cyclotron resonance (ECR) plasma oxidation can create the oxide films on Ti-6Al-4V alloy surface, and this technique improves the ability of its osseointegration. The purpose of this study was to investigate the characteristics and calcification ability of the oxide films. X-ray diffraction (XRD) peaks of rutile phase were intensified with increasing the temperature. Scanning electron microscopy (SEM) images showed a crater-like structure, and bonding strengths between the substrate and oxide film reached a maximum at 400°C. Calcium phosphate (CaP) compounds after calcification process were identified as octacalcium phosphate (OCP) and precipitation amount was maximized at 400°C. The results suggested that the altered surface of Ti-6Al-4V alloy by ECR plasma oxidation might have the potential of accelerating the ability of its osseointegration through enhancement of OCP.

llm.relevance_to_user: 本文研究了Ti-6Al-4V合金的表面改性以提高骨整合能力，但未涉及增材制造或多孔结构设计。
llm.why_not_core: No additive manufacturing, no LPBF fabrication, no mechanical testing (static or fatigue), and no porous structure design or stress shielding analysis.

summary_zh.motivation: 探索ECR等离子体氧化在Ti-6Al-4V表面形成氧化膜并增强骨整合能力。
summary_zh.method: 在不同温度下进行ECR等离子体氧化处理，XRD、SEM表征膜层，钙化实验评估磷酸钙沉积。
summary_zh.result: 400°C时氧化膜结合强度最大，钙化后形成磷酸八钙且沉积量最多。
summary_zh.validation: 通过SEM图像和XRD图谱验证膜层结构，钙化实验评估沉积能力。

summary_en.motivation: To investigate whether electron cyclotron resonance plasma oxidation can create oxide films on Ti-6Al-4V alloy surfaces and improve osseointegration potential.
summary_en.method: Oxide films were formed on Ti-6Al-4V by ECR plasma oxidation at various temperatures; XRD and SEM characterized the films, and calcification tests assessed calcium phosphate precipitation.
summary_en.result: The oxide film showed a crater-like structure and maximum bonding strength at 400°C, where octacalcium phosphate precipitation was highest after calcification.
summary_en.validation: Validation was conducted by SEM imaging of surface morphology, XRD phase identification, and calcification assays to quantify calcium phosphate formation.

papers.title: Exponential Savings in Agnostic Active Learning through Abstention
papers.abstract: We show that in pool-based active classification without assumptions on the underlying distribution, if the learner is given the power to abstain from some predictions by paying the price marginally smaller than the average loss $1/2$ of a random guess, exponential savings in the number of label requests are possible whenever they are possible in the corresponding realizable problem. We extend this result to provide a necessary and sufficient condition for exponential savings in pool-based active classification under the model misspecification.

llm.why_not_core: No FEA surrogate modeling, no uncertainty quantification, no constraint handling, and no transferability to implant/biomechanics design.

summary_zh.method: 理论分析给出必要充分条件
summary_zh.result: 证明了弃权可带来指数级节省

summary_en.motivation: To characterize when abstention enables exponential label savings in agnostic active classification.
summary_en.method: Theoretical derivation of necessary and sufficient conditions for exponential savings under model misspecification.
summary_en.result: Abstention allows exponential savings whenever realizable savings are possible in the corresponding realizable problem.

papers.title: A Simple yet Brisk and Efficient Active Learning Platform for Text Classification
papers.abstract: In this work, we propose the use of a fully managed machine learning service, which utilizes active learning to directly build models from unstructured data. With this tool, business users can quickly and easily build machine learning models and then directly deploy them into a production ready hosted environment without much involvement from data scientists. Our approach leverages state-of-the-art text representation like OpenAI's GPT2 and a fast implementation of the active learning workflow that relies on a simple construction of incremental learning using linear models, thus providing a brisk and efficient labeling experience for the users. Experiments on both publicly available and real-life insurance datasets empirically show why our choices of simple and fast classification algorithms are ideal for the task at hand.

llm.relevance_to_user: 该论文主要针对文本分类的主动学习，与有限元代理模型、生物力学或植入物设计无任何关联。
llm.why_not_core: This paper focuses on active learning for text classification using GPT2 and linear models, with no application to FEA, surrogate modeling, constraint optimization, uncertainty quantification, or biomechanical implant design.

summary_zh.result: 在公开和保险数据集上验证了该方法的效率

summary_en.motivation: To enable business users to quickly build and deploy text classification models without deep data science involvement.
summary_en.method: Active learning combining GPT2 text representations with incremental linear models for efficient labeling.
summary_en.result: The approach demonstrated brisk and efficient performance on public and insurance text datasets.
summary_en.validation: Empirical evaluation on publicly available and real-world insurance datasets.
